text:
alice_support: Customer reported function-call failures after we rolled the v2 renames this morning. They call `TextSummarizerV2` and get a 400: "unknown tool 'TextSummarizerV2'". They say their agent previously used `Text_Summarizer_v2` (old name).
ben_oncall: Logs show the router returned tool_lookup=old-name-match and then runtime tried to invoke `text_summarizer_v2` binary, which doesn't exist on that host. Stacktrace: `ToolDispatchError: no executable for tool id 'text_summarizer_v2'`.
carlos_sre: Is this only in the eu-west cluster or across regions? Customer was routed to eu-west-1.
dana_runtime: Quick summary: we renamed tool IDs last week (kebab -> snake case) and added aliases, but the alias-sync job failed on a subset of nodes during the deploy. Some hosts have alias map with old IDs, others with new.
eli_prod: Confirmed: registry shows canonical id `text-summarizer-v2` with alias `TextSummarizerV2` and `text_summarizer_v2`. But the local registry cache on inference nodes has stale mapping for `TextSummarizerV2` -> `text_summarizer_v1` (old). That explains wrong tool being picked.
alice_support: Customer impact: generation returns irrelevant content from v1 model for ~10% of requests, intermittent. They opened a ticket and are asking for rollback.
fiona_engineering: Is there a hotfix other than full rollback? We can force bypass alias map and route by canonical ID, but need to map incoming calls.
dana_runtime: Suggested patch: if alias lookup hits a mismatch, fall back to registry canonical by doing an authoritative lookup against control-plane registry API (sync endpoint) before dispatch. Implemented as async: first try cache, on mismatch (tool not present locally), call control-plane and re-resolve. Adds ~5-10ms p95.
carlos_sre: Also propose running the alias-reconcile job across eu-west via playbook: `scripts/reconcile_tool_aliases --region eu-west --force` — will update local caches. Schedule a short maintenance window, but it's safe.
ben_oncall: I'm watching the deploy logs. I can kick off reconcile now. Any objections?
eli_prod: Go ahead. Also add a one-off migration to delete ambiguous uppercase aliases (we had both `TextSummarizerV2` and `textsummarizerv2` created by a bad import).
fiona_engineering: Filed PR with conservative fallback: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4823 — checks alias then does authoritative lookup; added metrics `alias_mismatch_count` and alarm.
ben_oncall: Reconcile job started at 11:12 UTC. I'll post progress.
deploy-bot: reconcile_tool_aliases job started by ben_oncall at commit 3a7f8d.
ben_oncall: Reconcile completed on 8/12 hosts in eu-west; 2 hosts still reporting permission timeout to registry (403).
carlos_sre: I'm SSHing to those nodes to check IAM role. Looks like expired instance profile on two hosts (rolled over last night). Restarting the instance profile agent.
dana_runtime: After reconcile, monitored the traffic: alias_mismatch_count dropped from ~120/min to <2/min. Customer reports normalized responses.
alice_support: Customer confirmed majority of their calls now return v2 outputs. They asked for postmortem and timeline. I'll draft incident note.
eli_prod: Action items: (1) merge PR 4823, (2) extend reconcile to all regions, (3) add pre-deploy check verifying alias-map propagation across nodes, (4) cleanup duplicate-case aliases.
fiona_engineering: I'll add the pre-deploy propagation check to the CI deploy pipeline and add unit tests for case-insensitive collisions.
alice_support: Thanks all — marking this one as resolved for customer. Will attach logs and steps in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
